en-US.description: The dedicated desktop edition of SimTradeLab, delivering a fast, secure, and fully local environment for strategy development, backtesting, simulation, and broker-side deployment.
en-US.longDescription:
SimTradeDesk is the dedicated desktop edition of SimTradeLab, delivering a fast, secure, and fully local environment for strategy development, backtesting, simulation, and broker-side deployment. It builds on the open-source SimTradeLab core while offering a refined, commercial-grade desktop experience.
No Python. No environment setup. Just download, install, and start building strategies.
Features
- PTrade-compatible API — 46 core APIs; strategies run identically on PTrade and locally
- Strategy editor — autocompletion and syntax highlighting for PTrade API
- Backtesting — A-share historical data with real-time log streaming
- Parameter optimizer — hyperparameter search with walk-forward validation (optimization period + holdout period)
- Results visualization — equity curves, drawdown charts, trade history, and key metrics
- Backtest comparison — overlay NAV curves with time-axis alignment and side-by-side metric tables
- Version history — automatic strategy snapshots with diff view and one-click restore
- CSV / PNG export — export data tables and charts
- Built-in terminal — integrated command-line panel for quick debugging
- Multi-language UI — Chinese / English / German
- Cross-platform — Windows, macOS, Linux

zh-CN.description: SimTradeLab 专用桌面版，为策略开发、回测、模拟及券商端部署提供快速、安全且完全本地的环境。
zh-CN.longDescription:
SimTradeDesk 是 SimTradeLab 的专用桌面版，提供快速、安全且完全本地化的环境，用于策略开发、回测、模拟及券商端部署。它在开源的 SimTradeLab 核心基础上，打造了精致、商用级的桌面体验。
无需 Python，无需环境配置。只需下载、安装，即可开始构建策略。
功能特性
- 兼容 PTrade 的 API — 46 个核心 API；策略在 PTrade 与本地运行表现一致
- 策略编辑器 — 为 PTrade API 提供自动补全与语法高亮
- 回测 — A 股历史数据支持实时日志流
- 参数优化器 — 超参数搜索，支持前向验证（优化期 + 保留期）
- 结果可视化 — 资金曲线、回撤图表、交易记录及关键指标
- 回测对比 — 对齐时间轴叠加净值曲线，并排展示指标表格
- 版本历史 — 自动保存策略快照，支持差异查看与一键还原
- CSV / PNG 导出 — 导出数据表格与图表
- 内置终端 — 集成命令行面板，便于快速调试
- 多语言界面 — 中文 / 英文 / 德文
- 跨平台 — 支持 Windows、macOS、Linux
zh-CN.name: SimTradeDesk
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
[0.8.0] - 2026-11-08
Added
- The strategy workspace now guides admins through a four-step flow that builds an encrypted strategy package from pasted source.
- Membership activation is recorded as a dated term with its seat count, and renewal, upgrade, and downgrade are handled through one flow.
Changed
- Membership activation and renewal dates and seat counts are computed by the server; the admin portal no longer accepts a client-supplied expiry date.
- Checkout accepts only the price IDs configured on the server; an unknown price fails instead of silently assigning a tier.
- Editing a user's notes or PTrade account bindings no longer changes their subscription state.
- Admin data access for subscriptions, orders, devices, and referrals is scoped to the admin's own brand.
- Device bindings can no longer bypass the per-account device limit.
- Sign-in, password-change, and license-verification attempts are rate limited.
- Subscription and license expiry are now judged against server time; changing the local system clock no longer extends access.
- Sign-in and device verification now require a successful online check on every launch; the offline grace period has been removed.
- Expired subscriptions can still sign in so users can reach the renewal entry; feature access is blocked server-side, and super admins are exempt from subscription expiry.
- License enforcement is hardened: license checks default on (removing the env flag no longer disables them), missing license files fail closed, customer-side admins cannot bypass a revoked license, auth-server deployments require the Supabase revocation control plane, and customer installers refuse to build without the license-verify URL.
- Normal deploys now target Tencent Cloud only. Supabase schema and Edge Function deploys are explicit manual commands (npm run deploy:supabase:*), and releases no longer deploy Supabase automatically.
- Removed the redundant root deploy.sh/deploy.cmd wrappers and duplicate deploy aliases; npm run deploy:tencent:* and npm run deploy:supabase:* are the supported entrypoints.
Fixed
- Admin portal user search now respects pagination and reports an accurate total instead of returning every match at once.
- Brand admins now only see their own brand's administrators in the admin list.
- Adding an administrator with an invalid role is now rejected instead of creating an unusable account.
- Strategy delivery errors no longer expose internal error details.
